question: A good memory or something from when Thearesia-sama was a little girl!
answer: For birthdays when she was very young, Thames nii-sama would carry her on his shoulders, then Carlan nii-sama or Kajiles, and then she'd play outside with Bertol. She had the "Blessing of the Reaper", so she wouldn't often try to play outdoors by herself, so without her birthday as an excuse, her siblings weren't able to take her along to play.
